FREE · 3D · ARCADE MISSIONS

Auto Rickshaw
Drift League

Drive a yellow-and-green tuk-tuk through arcade challenges. Drift, boost, earn rupees, buy new rickshaws and unlock missions.

Choose an event to see its objective. Clear missions to earn your checkered flag.

Best race: none yet

Controls

DRIVEW↑ gas
S↓ brake / reverse
AD←→ steer
DRIFTHold Space in a corner and steer. The longer you slide, the bigger the multiplier.
BOOSTHold Shift for nitro. It drains fast and recharges while you don’t use it.
SYSTEMR reset to track
Esc pause
M mute
MOBILE TOUCHTap TOUCH CONTROLS during a race to show or hide the on-screen buttons. Hold a button to drive; lift your finger to release it. Landscape mode gives the clearest view.

Game features

ARCADE MISSIONSComplete objectives to win and unlock the next challenge.
DRIFT SCORINGSlip angle, speed and time build a combo multiplier up to ×8.
CHECKPOINT ROUTEMissions use drift-score and clean-driving objectives; no lap system.
NITRO + FXColourful boost trail, dust, skid marks and a camera that widens with speed.
LIVE AUDIOReal auto-rickshaw engine sound that revs with your speed, plus skid, nitro and countdown effects.
YOUR RECORDSMission unlocks and best race are saved locally on your device.
Credits
Race track map: “Race Track Map” by Mabaso_J on Sketchfab (CC-BY-4.0) — track layout traced from it.
Auto-rickshaw: low-poly tuk-tuk model, textured as supplied.
Built with Three.js. No account, no ads, no downloads.
